---
title: "Architecture"
---

The **FSPP Research Workbench** is a modular monorepo. Shared infrastructure lives in one reusable Python package, while research projects own their theories, codebooks, data, and publication surfaces.

## Repository Shape

```text
src/fspp_workbench/                           reusable research infrastructure
src/fspp_workbench/projects/sacrificial_debt/ Sacrificial Debt domain logic
projects/sacrificial-debt/                    canonical project research assets
publication/                                  Workbench website shell
publication/engineering/                      Engineering subsite
publication/projects/sacrificial-debt/        Sacrificial Debt subsite
schemas/                                      checked-in generated JSON Schema
tests/                                        guardrail and infrastructure tests
```

## Subsite Model

The website is composed of independent Quarto projects that render into one GitHub Pages output tree.

```text
publication/_site/
├── index.html
├── engineering/
└── projects/
    └── sacrificial-debt/
```

Each subsite owns its own `_quarto.yml`, navigation, CSS, and content structure. Every subsite links back to the Workbench home.

## Package Boundary

Shared modules may define generic infrastructure for provenance, IDs, validation, evidence chains, claim audit, publication, and release reproducibility.

Project modules may define project-specific schema, controlled vocabularies, state machines, and interpretation rules.
